body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Scosche showcased 'solCHAT', its solar powered Bluetooth speaker phone at CES 2010, integrated solar panel continuously re-charges the lithium ion battery and includes windshield and visor mounting options.
